_about: Browser speed parameters. 'target' is the response-time goal; 'race' is re-read by race.py on its own; the launcher passes 'browser' to the browser when it opens.

tor._about: Tor entry: 'direct' (no bridge, the default here) or 'bridge' (WebTunnel, needs ~/.smiley/bridges.sh with your own bridges). conflux_ux: 'throughput' or 'latency'. exit_countries / middle_countries: relay country codes (empty = any).
